name: EXP-7(a) Predator
description: The EXP-7(a) Predator was an experimental but powerful hunting blaster rifle manufactured by Exotac Arms during the Galactic Civil War. A large and bulky rifle, the hunter Kaori Batta owned one of the three existing EXP-7(a) models, and later used it to kill a modrol, a large predatory creature, on the planet Neftali.
